status.principle: A terminal state distinguishes a measured workload canary from setup-only adapter work.

honest_verdict.principle: The verdict must state identity, exact equality, measured benefit, fallback, and rollback with a terminal prefix.

verdict_class.principle: A closed class prevents incomplete or unsafe workload evidence from becoming positive.

upstream_gate_receipt.principle: The canary must identify the eligible V567 production evidence that authorized execution.

frozen_workload_and_timing_contract.principle: Workloads, warm-up, pairing, timers, and thresholds must be fixed before outcomes exist.

per_unit_rows.principle: Every workload, seed, and adapter condition needs request, decision, exact, and cost metrics.

disabled_identity_rows.principle: Native-versus-disabled bytes expose any supposedly inert behavior change.

enabled_route_and_fallback_rows.principle: Every route, abstention, exception, and fallback must remain visible.

exact_output_and_candidate_receipt.principle: Promotion requires exact accepted outputs and complete candidate preservation.

measured_work_and_latency_rows.principle: Direct checker, serialization, persistence, process, and wall-time receipts replace synthetic units.

restart_and_rollback_receipts.principle: A production route needs exact recovery after process and configuration changes.

shortcut_attack_matrix.principle: Identity, leakage, retry, timing, and fallback attacks test the actual production boundary.

production_workload_canary_ready_score.principle: One binary field states whether the canary is complete and safe.

production_workload_promotion_candidate_.principle: A separate score gates default promotion on measured benefit and safety.

aggregate_row_recomputation.principle: Every headline must derive from emitted workload rows.

gate_check_summary.principle: A blocked run must name the failed upstream, workload, timer, or runtime check and value.

preconditions_checked.principle: Resource and fixture receipts separate blocked execution from null production value.

protected_files_unchanged.principle: The canary must preserve active orchestration files.

inference_substrate.principle: The artifact must declare production pipeline and exact verification with no LLM inference.

verifier_is_oracle.principle: The learned route is not authority; the native exact verifier remains separate.

field_provenance.principle: Each benefit and safety field must point to raw workload rows and reducers.

random_seed.principle: Fixed order and tie seeds make the paired canary repeatable.

duration_s.principle: Monotonic wall time exposes omitted workload or rollback work.

tests_run.principle: Named unit and E2E receipts prove the production path executed.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: A final hash detects mutation after the verdict.

tests_run.command: manual e2e-plan check: Exp6563 exercises the VerifyRepairPipeline production adapter path; ops/e2e-test-plan.md has no direct Exp6563 entry
